title: A Third Of Americans Are Now Tattooed
hook: Tattoos stopped signaling rebellion once they became ordinary.
closing: Tattoos stopped being rebellion once a third of America had one. That is normal now.
question: What made tattoos mainstream?

segments.say: In 2006, 16 percent of Americans had tattoos. Today, roughly one in three does.
Tattoo prevalence reached 37 percent among women, helping lift the total to about a third of all adults.
That tattoo majority is not just first-timers: one in five Americans has more than one, twice as many as stopped at one.
